name: uplift-ui
description: Restyle an existing web frontend into a modern, responsive, user-friendly interface with its own identity, without breaking its behaviour. Brings tokens with light/dark, 12 palettes, 4 flavours, ~80 motion classes, popups and confirms, info tips, searchable paged tables, empty states, theme-aware illustrations, modern surfaces (mesh and pattern backgrounds, glass and gradient-border cards, bento grid, dock, device frames), ready-made blocks (panels, split inspector, callouts, sticky action bar, many table styles, sign-in layouts with SSO, two-step code and password strength), motif marks, React components and an audit checklist.
